items.title: 13.3 Gas ka pressure aur PV = ⅓Nm<v²> ki derivation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.3, gas pressure and PV = ⅓Nm<v²> (PDF 6-9).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory se hum aisi equation nikal sakte hain jo gas ki macroscopic properties (pressure aur volume) ko us ke molecules ki microscopic properties (mass aur speed) se jorti hai. Farz karein ek hi molecule ek cube (dabba) mein chal raha hai jis ki har side L hai (Fig 13.2). Is molecule ka mass m aur speed v hai. Yeh aage peeche chalta hai aur regular intervals (barabar waqfe) par deewaron se takrata hai, is liye gas ke pressure mein hissa daalta hai. Pehle hum is ek molecule ka deewar par pressure nikalenge, phir sab molecules ka total pressure.

Kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas bohat se chhote particles (atoms ya molecules) se bani hai jo hamesha random motion (be-tarteeb harkat) mein hain. Yeh har taraf azadi se chalte hain aur aapas mein aur deewaron se baar baar takrate hain. Har takkar mein molecule ka momentum badalta hai, is liye woh deewar par force lagata hai. Gas ka pressure = in takkaron se deewar ke har unit area par lagne wali force. Takkarein elastic hain, is liye energy zaya nahi hoti, aur molecules ki average kinetic energy gas ke absolute temperature (Kelvin mein) ke directly proportional (seedha tanasub) hai: <K.E.> ∝ T. Is liye temperature barhe to molecules tez chalte hain, takkarein zyada hoti hain aur pressure barhta hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Mole (gram-molecule) aur Avogadro's number mein kya farq hai? Kya Avogadro's number substance ki state (solid, liquid, gas) par depend karta hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: mole aur Avogadro's number mein kya farq hai? Kya Avogadro's number state par depend karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Mole amount of substance (cheez ki miqdar) ki unit hai. Avogadro's number (6.02 × 10²³) woh number hai jitne particles ek mole mein hote hain. Ek mole solid ho, liquid ho ya gas, us mein hamesha 6.02 × 10²³ particles hote hain. Is liye Avogadro's number state par depend nahi karta; yeh constant hai.

rows: Kisi cheez ki ek khaas miqdar
Ek mole mein particles ki ginti
Is ka mass substance par depend karta hai (O₂ ka 32 g, N₂ ka 28 g)
Har substance aur har state mein wahi rehta hai (constant)

Pressure deewar ke unit area par force hai. Har baar jab gas ka particle (molecule ya atom) deewar se takrata hai to deewar par force lagata hai, aur yeh force deewar ke poore area par phail jati hai.

Ab ek takkar dekhein: velocity v wala molecule x-axis ke saath cube ki ek deewar se takrata hai aur elastic tareeqe se opposite direction (ulti taraf) mein velocity –v se wapas aata hai. Us ka momentum mv se −mv ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Kinetic theory of gases ka Boyle's law aur Charles' law se kya relation (talluq) hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: kinetic theory Boyle's law aur Charles' law ko kaise samjhati hai?
blocks.explanation: PV = ⅓Nm<v²> mein <v²> sirf temperature par depend karta hai. Boyle's law: temperature aur N fixed hon to PV constant; volume kam karein to molecules deewaron se zyada baar takrate hain aur pressure barhta hai. Charles' law: pressure fixed ho aur temperature barhe to <v²> barhta hai, is liye pressure wahi rakhne ke liye volume ko temperature (Kelvin) ke proportional barhna parta hai (V ∝ T).

blocks.text: Kitab Eq. (13.14) ko PV = ⅓ρ<v²> chhapti hai. ρ = mN/V mein volume pehle hi shamil hai, is liye sahi formula P = ⅓ρ<v²> hai (Example 13.1 bhi yahi istemal karta hai).

blocks.title: Example 13.2
blocks.problem: Kamre ke temperature, maslan 25 °C, par hawa ke molecules (O₂ aur N₂) ki rms speed kya hai?
steps: O₂ ka mass = 32 u aur N₂ ka mass = 28 u
Oxygen O₂ ka mass = 32 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 5.3 × 10⁻²⁶ kg
Nitrogen N₂ ka mass = 28 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 4.6 × 10⁻²⁶ kg
Oxygen ki rms speed (formula vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m) topic 13.4 mein derive hota hai):

blocks.text: Isi tarah nitrogen ki rms speed vᵣₘₛ = 515 m s⁻¹ ≈ 5.15 × 10² m s⁻¹ aati hai (halka molecule, zyada speed). Note: calculator se dobara hisaab karein to oxygen ke liye taqreeban 482 m s⁻¹ aata hai; kitab ka 481 m s⁻¹ sirf rounding (gol karne) ka farq hai.
Hawa ke molecules ki speed awaz ki speed (taqreeban 340 m s⁻¹) se kaafi zyada hai.
Short summary (mukhtasar khulasa)

items: PV = nRT = Nk_BT; R = N_A k_B.
Ek molecule: Δp = −2mvₓ, waqt 2L/vₓ, F = mvₓ²/L, P = mvₓ²/V.
Sab molecules: <vₓ²> = <v²>/3, is liye PV = ⅓Nm<v²> aur P = ⅓ρ<v²>.
P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>; hawa ke molecules 25 °C par taqreeban 481-515 m s⁻¹.
